title: develop. — 'from screen to wall' one-shape product film
summary: A square, continuous one-take product film for a photo/print app. The wordmark 'develop.' collapses into its full-stop dot, the dot stretches into a black pill button ('Develop'), the cursor clicks, the pill morphs into a circle that opens into a photo card, which explodes into a photo grid; the cursor picks one and it goes full-bleed, a glass slider ('Golden hour 82') grades it, it becomes a phone lock screen, the phone sits beside a browser window on a soft blue wave, the image drags into a rebuilt store page ('the print', frame/size toggles, $129, Order print → Ordered ✓), then real hands hold the framed print and it resolves back to the wordmark with 'from screen to wall.' Smooth, Apple-calm, never cuts.
fit_reason: The 'one shape that morphs, driven by a cursor' grammar is perfect for showing a client-portal journey (login pill → dashboard card → course → support ticket) in a premium, calm, self-explanatory way.

palette.mood: light airy warm-grey canvas, black UI pills, a soft lavender-blue silk wave behind devices; photo content supplies the colour

typography.display: wide heavy grotesk lowercase wordmark with a round full stop (Helvetica Now Display Black Extended look)
typography.size_behaviour: one wordmark large left-centre at open and close; everything else is real-scale UI text
typography.notes: Almost no on-screen copy: the product UI is the text. Tagline 'from screen to wall.' small grey under the wordmark at the end.

button label fades in inside the pill
motion: continuous morph: dot → pill → circle → rounded card → grid → full-bleed (FLIP-style layout morphs with spring easing)
cursor drives every action (hover, click, drag, slider scrub)
lens magnifier bubble on the image

drag-and-drop of an image card from phone to browser
button morphs to a 'Ordered ✓' state then to a check pill
match to live-action hands holding a frame, then a hex-aperture fade

match cut UI → real framed print (black rectangle → frame)
aperture/iris close to the end card
ui_treatment: rebuilt, simplified UI (store page with swatches, size segmented control, price and CTA), floating on a soft background; devices are minimal mockups; cursor-driven

sound.music: soft ambient/electronic bed (no voice detected), -14 LUFS

cursor-driven continuous morph, zero hard cuts
rebuilt checkout UI: swatches, size toggle, price, button → 'Ordered ✓'

best_segments.what: Wordmark collapses to its dot, dot → pill 'Develop' → click → circle → photo card → grid. The whole one-shape idea in 4 s.
Frosted 'Golden hour' slider scrubbed by the cursor regrades the full-bleed photo, magnifier bubble.
Phone on a silk-wave background, browser window flies in, image dragged from phone into the store page.
Store page: frame swatch click, size toggle, Order print → Ordered ✓ → check pill.

recreate.how: Remotion or HTML+GSAP (Flip plugin) with one persistent element whose border-radius/size/position animate between states; a scripted SVG cursor with eased paths and click scale. Background silk wave = blurred SVG ribbons or a pre-rendered loop. The live-action print shot needs real footage or AI image-to-video.
recreate.prompt: Square, continuous one-take product film on warm light grey #eeeeea. A lowercase heavy wordmark collapses to its full stop; the dot stretches into a black pill button, a cursor clicks it, and the shape keeps morphing (circle, rounded card, grid, full-bleed) with spring easing, never cutting. Frosted-glass controls, a phone and browser window floating over a soft lavender-blue silk wave #c8d4fa, a rebuilt checkout with swatches and a button that turns into 'Ordered ✓'. End back on the wordmark with a small grey tagline.
